units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1:12">Y. Ber. IV, 7ᵇ</cite> top <he>היו מְשַׁלְשְׁלִין וכ׳</he> in (ed. Lehm. <he>מְשׁלְּשִׁין</he>) they lowered for them (the besiegers) two basketfuls of gold &c.; <he>פעם שִׁילְשְׁלוּ וכ׳</he> once they let down &c.; <cite ref="Sotah 49b:9">Sot. 49ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 64b:6">Men. 64ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 82b:16">B. Kam. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>מְשַׁלְּשִׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:11">Sabb. I, 11</cite> <he>משלשלין את הפסח וכ׳</he> the Passover lamb is let down into the stove &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 7:1">Tosef. Pes. VII, 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 4:3">Tosef. Bets. IV, 3</cite> <he>אין משלשלין אותן וכ׳</he> you must not let them down from the window, but you may let them slide down on ladders (v. ed. Zuck. note).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>נטלוהו ושִׁלְשְׁלוּהוּ</he> (<he>לו</he>) they seized him and let him down the wall; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>, end.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:4">Yeb. XVI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:8">121ᵃ</cite>) <he>מעשה שׁשִׁלְשְׁלוּהוּ לים וכ׳</he> it happened at ʿAsia with one whom they let down into the sea (as diver), and (in hauling him up) they brought up nothing but his leg.; Y. ib. 15ᵈ top <he>ששלשלהו הים</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Eruvin 87a:14">Erub. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>מְשַׁלְשֵׁל דלי וכ׳</he> he may let the bucket down and fill &c.; Tosef. ib. IX (VI), 24.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:2">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> <he>צריך לְשַׁלְשֵׁל</he> (on the Sabbath) one must let his cloak hang down (not tuck up as for travel).
Ib. ושִׁילְשְׁלָהּ ר׳ זעירא R. Z. pulled it down; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּלְשָׁל; f. מְשׁוּלְשֶׁלֶת hanging down.

<cite ref="Menachot 41b:13">Men. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>כמה תהא מש׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מְשׁוּלֶּשֶׁת</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) how far must the threads of the show-fringes hang down (beyond the border)?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:5">Yalk. Num. 750</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 750:5">ib.</cite> <he>מְשׁוּלְשָׁלוֹת ארבע</he> (Men. l. c. sing.) hanging down four finger-breadths.
